brief:
Schools in the northern West Bank village of Aqaba postponed the start of classes to 9 a.m. on Sunday, the first day of the academic year, as Israeli occupation forces continued military operations throughout the town, Shehab Wire reported. The delay affected students returning for a new term amid the ongoing security situation.

The raids coincided with a mass detention operation. Israeli forces arrested nine Palestinians during the sweep and held additional detainees whose identities were not immediately confirmed. Residents faced disruption to daily routines as the military presence persisted across Aqaba, located north of Tubas in the occupied West Bank.
